What's New in MHP GlucoTrack
• Glucose targets now fit people with diabetes: 4.4–7.2 mmol/L before meals, under 10.0 mmol/L after meals.
• Search: New search button on the home screen (English & Bengali).
• Waist-to-hip ratio: Optional waist and hip entry in the Weight Tracker.
• BMI: Now shows your category and a healthy weight range.
• Medicine reminders: Fixed. They now arrive on time in your local time zone. Allow "Alarms & reminders" if Android asks.
• Existing personal data remains safe and unchanged.
